evidence.quote: All courses are taught in English; therefore, a B2 level English proficiency is required.
The tuition fee is 7,000 USD / year for this program.
The following documents need to be submitted during the application procedure by all applicants through our online application platform - that you can reach here:

name.fr: Certificat d'études (diplôme de fin d'études secondaires)
Relevés de notes des 2-3 dernières années académiques
name.en: Transcripts of the last 2-3 academic years

value.quotedAs: transcripts (end of year reports) of the last 2-3 academic years

name.fr: Preuve de citoyenneté et/ou de résidence permanente (passeport)
name.en: Certificate or proof of citizenship and/or permanent residence (passport)

value.quotedAs: Certificate or proof of citizenship and/or permanent residence

evidence.quote: certificate of education (school leaving qualification such as high school diploma, document of graduation or any equivalent; university degree certificate or any equivalent; all in English / translated)
Short Resume/CV (personal details, educational background, work experience, language skills, additional skills)
Medical Certificate - please see a template here

notes: Tuition is stated as 7,000 USD/year on the programme page, but the facts format expects minor units of a two-decimal currency (amountMinor=700000 for 7,000.00 USD). The university-wide fee table lists 'Business Informatics *' as 7,000 USD/year with the asterisk meaning September-only start. Application deadline 15th June is stated as the self-financed procedure deadline and no year is given, so it is a recurring deadline.

note.fr: Un certificat d'études secondaires et un examen d'entrée écrit et oral en mathématiques sont requis. Vérifiez les conditions exactes de l'examen d'entrée.
note.en: A high school certificate and a written and oral entrance exam in Mathematics are required. Check the exact entrance exam conditions.

evidence.quote: Admission requires a high school certificate and passing a written and oral entrance exam in Mathematics.
